### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change enabling tagless clients to detect feature-flag updates. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #2866 by making `GetEvaluations` hash all feature flags when the request tag is empty, allowing tagless clients to detect flag changes. **Changes:** - Treats an empty tag as “all flags,” consistent with the evaluator and `GetFeatureFlags`. - Copies the feature slice before hashing to avoid sorting the shared cached slice. - Adds regression tests for stale and matching evaluation IDs with an empty tag. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `pkg/​api/​api/​api_grpc.go` | Hashes a copy of all features for empty-tag requests. | | `pkg/​api/​api/​api_grpc_test.go` | Tests empty-tag change detection and unchanged-ID responses. |
Review effort: Balanced

Thank you for your contribution!
Let me know if you have any feedback on the project in the discussions or issues.
